scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix desktop
scripts.start: concurrently -k "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:desktop"
scripts.start:desktop: wait-on http://localhost:4200 http://localhost:3001/api/dashboard && npm run start --prefix desktop
scripts.start:production: concurrently -k "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run electron:production --prefix desktop"
